# Exercise 1

Retrieve every public repository in the `posit-dev` organization and build a data frame with the name, primary language, star count, and last push date. Report the number of repositories and pages, tabulate the language treating missing as its own category, and find the five most recently pushed repositories.

```{r}
# Comment this out if you have not stored a GitHub token with gitcreds::gitcreds_set(),
# and remove the authentication line from each solution below
token = gitcreds::gitcreds_get()$password
```

```{r}
resps = request("https://api.github.com/orgs/posit-dev/repos") |>
  req_url_query(per_page = 100, type = "public") |>
  req_auth_bearer_token(token) |>
  req_timeout(10) |>
  req_perform_iterative(
    next_req = iterate_with_link_url(),
    max_reqs = Inf, progress = FALSE
  )

repos = resps |> resps_data(\(resp) resp_body_json(resp))

df = tibble::tibble(
  name = purrr::map_chr(repos, "name"),
  language = purrr::map_chr(repos, "language", .default = NA_character_),
  stars = purrr::map_int(repos, "stargazers_count"),
  pushed_at = purrr::map_chr(repos, "pushed_at", .default = NA_character_) |>
    lubridate::ymd_hms(tz = "UTC")
)

c(repos = nrow(df), pages = length(resps))
df |> dplyr::count(language, sort = TRUE)
df |> dplyr::slice_max(pushed_at, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE, na_rm = TRUE)
```

`max_reqs = Inf` avoids truncating the collection at httr2's default of 20 pages. `with_ties = FALSE` returns at most five repositories, matching the Python result. Live counts and ordering can change between runs.











```{python}
token = r.token

url = "https://api.github.com/orgs/posit-dev/repos"
params = {"per_page": 100, "type": "public"}
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
repos = []
pages = 0

while url is not None:
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    repos.extend(resp.json())
    pages += 1
    url = resp.links.get("next", {}).get("url")
    params = None

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": [repo["name"] for repo in repos],
    "language": [repo["language"] for repo in repos],
    "stars": [repo["stargazers_count"] for repo in repos],
    "pushed_at": pd.to_datetime([repo["pushed_at"] for repo in repos], utc=True),
})

len(df), pages
df["language"].value_counts(dropna=False)
df.dropna(subset=["pushed_at"]).nlargest(5, "pushed_at")
```

`dropna=False` counts missing languages. Dates are parsed in UTC, and rows without a push date are excluded from the most-recent list.
